scope: Read-only V8 profile of actual full owner entry after successful T13 complete source producer; measurement only, not another qualification attempt
runtime: PinnedNode24.21.0; heap4096; profiler writes only fresh /tmp log and possible new prefixed diagnostic owner report
requirements: Start only after reviewed source V7 evidence commit and both source tests terminal; freeze bothroots program/HEAD throughout.
Pre/post physical hash+size of ALL tracked files on both roots plus HEADs; no source-byte or result/verdict cache.
Fresh output/log/receipt paths; kill entire process group at diagnostic deadline and reap before snapshots.
No source edits, canonical transaction, new registration, push/Actions or publish.
Even a completed profiled owner report is diagnostic; a fresh original1800s unprofiled command still needed for planned owner qualification.
Clear inherited RC_* and GIT_* from actual owner child; explicitly disable lazy fetch and replacement, terminal prompts.
Capture malformed/partial/nonregular output and snapshot/log errors as terminal receipt data; preserve bytes/hash when readable; no malformed output pass.
A timeout is expected diagnostic data; collection errors or missing log exit nonzero after receipt. Zero diagnostic exit never denotes owner qualification.
next: Process captured V8 ticks after terminal; use actual reached stacks to select next bounded repair, or justify original full owner attempt if complete diagnostic unexpectedly succeeds.
snapshot_limits: All tracked regular-file content SHA/size/mode plus HEADs on bothroots; this does not bind ignored peer modules, untracked source, Git internals, filesystem aliases or external runtimes. Exclusive trusted writer, no atomic hostile-filesystem assertion.
